title: Company-wide policies and process documentation
author: Ava Martinez
body:
Summary:
This document provides Redwood Inference's canonical company-wide policies and standardized processes for access & permissions, change management, data management, procurement & expenses, vendor management, travel, and internal templates. It is written for managers, engineers, and cross-functional partners as the single source of truth to ensure consistent execution, auditability, and compliance.

Scope and applicability:
- Applies to all full-time employees, part-time employees, contractors, and external vendors with access to Redwood systems or data.
- Any exception requires a documented risk-and-exceptions request and written sign-off from Security and People Ops.

Owners and contacts:
- Policy owner: People Ops (people-ops@redwood.com)
- Security (access & data exceptions): security@redwood.com
- Procurement & vendor questions: procurement@redwood.com
- Travel & expenses: finance@redwood.com
- Process escalation: operations-vendor@redwood.com

1) Access & permissions
Purpose:
Ensure least-privilege access, timely approvals, periodic certification, and auditable revocation.

Principles:
- Default to least privilege and role-based groups.
- Documented business justification required for privileged access.
- MFA required for all SSO-enabled accounts; additional controls for CONFIDENTIAL/RESTRICTED data.
- Access certification cadence: 90 days for high-privilege groups, 180 days for standard groups.

Access groups (summary):
Group | Typical members | Approver | Review cadence | Example resources
sys-admins | Platform & infra engineers | Eng Platform manager | 90 days | Kubernetes clusters, VPCs
model-ops | Serving/runtime engineers | Runtime lead | 90 days | Model registry, GPU pools
data-analysts | BI/Analytics engineers | Data platform manager | 180 days | Redshift, Looker
finance-admins | Finance team | Finance manager | 180 days | Billing, payroll systems

Standard request workflow:
1. Submit a Jira RED-ACCESS request with requested group, justification, and duration (if temporary).
2. Approver (manager/owner) responds within 72 hours; People Ops triages within 48 hours.
3. On approval, IAM provisioning adds the user and logs the action.

Emergency access and break-glass:
- Request emergency access via on-call channel; a retroactive RED-ACCESS ticket must be created within 24 hours.
- Emergency access expires after 8 hours by default; extensions require approver approval and audit notes.

Offboarding and revocation:
- Offboarding checklist removes SSO access, deprovisions accounts, reclaims hardware, and records completion in RED-ACCESS ticket.

2) Change management
Purpose:
Standardize proposals, testing, approvals, and deployment to safeguard reliability while enabling appropriate velocity.

Change categories:
- Standard: Low-risk, pre-authorized routine actions.
- Normal: Requires CAB review with rollback and verification plans.
- Emergency: Implement immediately to mitigate incidents; post-facto CAB review required.

Normal change workflow:
1. Create CHANGE ticket in Jira RED-CHG with scope, rollback plan, test plan, owner, and risk assessment.
2. Ensure CI checks, unit tests, and security scans pass.
3. Submit to CAB (Tuesdays 10:00-11:00 PT) for approval when required.
4. Schedule change in appropriate deployment window and execute with an observer.
5. Perform post-change verification (smoke tests and 24-72 hour monitoring).

Rollback and post-change requirements:
- Every non-trivial change must include a tested rollback plan and estimated TTR.
- Any rollback requires a postmortem within 3 business days.

Approvals and responsibilities:
- Service owner: implementation and rollback steps.
- SRE/Observability: monitoring and SLO impact sign-off.
- Security: approval for changes impacting auth or data plane.
- CAB: approval for Normal changes with cross-team impact or spend > $10,000.

3) Data management
Classification:
- PUBLIC: Safe to share externally.
- INTERNAL: Default for internal operational data.
- CONFIDENTIAL: Customer PII, secrets, contract-sensitive financials.
- RESTRICTED: Regulated data (PCI, PHI); requires legal/security sign-off.

Handling rules by class:
- Encryption: CONFIDENTIAL/RESTRICTED must be encrypted at rest (AES-256) and in transit (TLS 1.2+).
- Access: Principle of least privilege; MFA enforced for CONFIDENTIAL/RESTRICTED.
- Retention: INTERNAL default 3 years; CONFIDENTIAL per contract (typ. 7 years); RESTRICTED per regulation.
- Sharing: External sharing of CONFIDENTIAL/RESTRICTED requires a DPA and Procurement/Legal approval.

Lifecycle and ownership:
- Data owners register datasets in the Data Catalog with classification, retention, owner, and access groups.
- Data stewards manage quality, approve access, and validate retention policies.

Incident handling:
- Follow Security incident response playbook; notify security@redwood.com immediately for CONFIDENTIAL/RESTRICTED exposures.
- Preserve logs and forensic copies; do not modify evidence before consulting Security.

4) Procurement & expenses
Procurement approval matrix:
Spend (USD) | Required approvals | Process
< $5,000 | Team lead | Self-serve purchase with corporate card; record in Coupa
$5,000 - $50,000 | Manager + Finance | Create PR in Coupa; Procurement assists with vendor terms
> $50,000 | Director + Procurement + Legal | RFP recommended; Procurement manages vendor evaluation and contracts

Vendor onboarding checklist:
1. Submit vendor intake in Coupa with scope, data access, and contact details.
2. Procurement performs risk assessment and security questionnaire.
3. Legal reviews and signs MSA and DPA as required.
4. Procurement issues PO and sets payment terms.

Expense policy highlights:
- Submit receipts in Expensify within 30 days.
- Per diem: domestic $75/day, international $125/day (exceptions require Finance approval).
- Hotel: standard room; upgrades need manager approval.
- Travel insurance required for high-risk regions; contact travel@redwood.com.

5) Vendor management
Governance:
- Quarterly vendor reviews for strategic vendors; annual security reassessment for vendors with CONFIDENTIAL/RESTRICTED access.
- Vendor scorecards include uptime, SLO adherence, security posture, and cost-effectiveness.
- Termination process ensures data return or verified destruction, credential revocation, and final invoice reconciliation.

SLA enforcement and escalation:
- Vendors must provide primary support contact and escalation path; Procurement monitors SLA breaches and coordinates remediation.
- Legal engages for repeated or unresolved SLA violations.

6) Travel policy
Booking and approvals:
- All business travel must be pre-approved in Concur; manager approval required.
- Use preferred vendors and company travel portal to ensure insurance coverage.

Safety and compliance:
- Travel to high-risk countries requires itinerary registration with security@redwood.com and explicit approval.
- Follow local public health guidance; Finance reimburses required testing when mandated.

Reimbursement timelines:
- Standard reimbursements processed within 15 business days of a complete submission.

7) Internal templates and examples
Canonical templates (locations):
- Access request template: /templates/access-request.md
- Change request template: /templates/change-request.md
- Vendor intake form: /templates/vendor-intake-form.xlsx
- Travel approval form: /templates/travel-approval.md
- Data registration form: /templates/data-registration.yaml

Example: Access request (fields):
- Requestor name
- Team
- System / Group requested
- Business justification
- Duration (if temporary)
- Approver (manager)

Governance and review cadence:
- People Ops runs an annual policy review in Q4; stakeholders may submit edits via the RED-POLICY GitHub repo or the policy feedback form.
- Security or Legal-mandated updates are published immediately with changelog entries and company announcements.

Appendices:
A. Useful links:
- Access requests: Jira RED-ACCESS
- Change tickets: Jira RED-CHG
- Vendor intake / Coupa: procurement portal
- Expense systems: Expensify / Concur

B. Emergency contacts:
- Security on-call: +1-555-0100 (internal)
- Ops escalation: ops-escalation@redwood.com

Change log:

End of document.
